channel.title: Jeevan P Rai — Writing
channel.description: Essays and field notes — the culture and heritage of Tulu Nadu, the systems I build, and ideas worth thinking through properly. Researched and sourced.

item.title: My Ancestors' Alphabet Just Became Code
item.description: How the endangered Tulu-Tigalari script got into Unicode — where heritage and engineering meet.

item.title: Nagara Panchami: The Forest We Never Cut
item.description: Every Tuluva family keeps a patch of forest it will never cut — the serpent's grove. Nagara Panchami and the sacred ecology of Tulu Nadu.

item.title: Aati: The Month With No Gods
item.description: The one month the Tulu calendar goes silent — Tulu Nadu's forbidden monsoon month, its wild medicine, and the bitter ritual of Aati Amavasya.

item.title: My House Was Whispering to Strangers
item.description: A story about DNS, control, and the evening I realised my ad-blocker was a scarecrow — on Pi-hole, unbound, and taking back my network.

item.title: Tulunad Heritage: The Land of Daivas
item.description: A deep, sourced dive into Tulu Nadu — Bhuta Kola, the Daivas, Nagaradhane, the Aati rituals, and the endangered Tulu-Tigalari script.

item.title: Why I'm writing this
item.description: A home for the things I want to understand properly and say in my own words — heritage, technology, and ideas, always with sources.
